info.description: Source-aligned with backend f3a1a4c and frontend 3972568. Login uses HttpOnly cookies, not JSON accessToken. Postman stores Set-Cookie. Log out before role switching. Default environment blocks resource mutations and provider callbacks. Never Run All with write flags enabled. Read docs/api-reference.md. No session cookies, API keys, personal passwords or payment secrets are included.
